import { describe, it, test } from "bun:test";

describe("The badge", () => {
  it("should say it scans", async () => {
    const page = await viz.given("a plain code", () => viz.open());
    await viz.when("the user types text", () => page.type("#t", "hi"));
    await viz.then("the badge says it scans", async () => {
      expect(await page.$eval("#b", (e) => e.textContent)).toBe("scans");
    });
  });

  describe("on a bad link", () => {
    test.concurrent("should fall back", async () => {
      await viz.given("a crafted link", () => 1);
      await viz.when("it opens");
      await viz.then("it falls back", () => 1);
      await viz.then(
        "and it says why",
        () => 1,
      );
    });
  });
});

describe("Styles", () => {
  for (const id of ["a", "b"]) {
    it(`should scan: ${id}`, async () => {
      await viz.given(`style ${id}`, () => 1);
      await viz.when("it is drawn", () => 1);
      await viz.then(`style ${id} scans`, () => 1);
    });
  }

  it.each([
    ["wide", 2],
    ["tall", 3],
  ] as const)("should fit %s", async (shape, n) => {
    await viz.given("a shape", () => shape);
    await viz.when("it is laid out", () => n);
    await viz.then("it fits", () => 1);
  });

  it("has nothing written", () => {
    expect(1).toBe(1);
  });

  it.skip("is parked", () => {});
});
